details:
Abandoned but Not Forgotten is a 10-scene illustrated comic designed to make robotic space exploration accessible, engaging, and emotionally resonant for general audiences. Through the conversations between a curious young space enthusiast named Alex and his fictional exploration robot, B.O.B., the story introduces readers to real NASA missions—including the Apollo Lunar Surface Experiments Package (ALSEP), the Mars rovers Sojourner and Opportunity, and the Voyager 1 and 2 spacecraft.

By pairing original illustrations with authentic archival NASA imagery and verified mission data, the comic addresses the challenge of communicating complex scientific achievements through human-centered storytelling. Rather than presenting technical specifications in isolation, it frames these spacecraft as silent pioneers that ventured into the unknown and continued gathering vital data long after their missions ended or human crews departed.

This project matters because public interest in space often focuses on human spaceflight, overlooking the robotic explorers that paved the way. By honoring the enduring scientific legacy of machines left behind on the Moon, Mars, and in interstellar space, Abandoned but Not Forgotten inspires curiosity and reminds audiences that while these explorers never return home, their discoveries permanently expand humanity’s understanding of the universe.
